svg.text: the simplest program: a command to a core group
a richer program: every core pulls its work and its code
cores, sent by the thread on X280 1
each core pulls its ranges from its
X280 core; an answer is a range
the word names an overlay; the
core loads it from DRAM if no slot
the core tells the kinds its range
held; the thread picks the next
(a drawn case; the reader has two slots)
one core in time: pull, load, call, tell

svg.text: the host's split, fixed per core
A whole pass by the thread's clock. The thread's choice loads 173 overlays in all, at most 4 on a core.
another core: it skips the command
a port, or the thread's ring
